_comment: Provenance for the one copied file in this slug: model_carotenoid.xml, the SBML of the
carotenoid-cleavage model of Bruno et al. 2016, imported verbatim from the Benchmark-Models-
PEtab collection. It is byte-identical (LF-normalized sha256) to the model shipped by the
Grein-2026-benchmark-subset-I/Bruno_JExpBot2016 slug, which pins the same upstream commit.
Everything else in this slug is written or generated locally: perturb_times.py and the
synthetic sigmaT*/ datasets it produces from the model at theta*, the standard/marginal confs,
score.py, and this benchmark's docs. theta_star_source.txt is a copy of that slug's

reference_optimum_source.note: Copy of Grein-2026-benchmark-subset-I/Bruno_JExpBot2016/best_fit_params.txt (theta*, the reference optimum, Obj = 32.556). The synthetic data is generated from the model at this point, so theta* is the exact ground truth.
